current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，该方法将动态时序图建模为快照序列，通过图摘要压缩原图并输入图自编码器，利用重构误差训练节点表征，再通过循环神经网络学习时间维度的依赖关系，实现高效的大规模时序图表示学习。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which models dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots, compresses the original graph via graph summarization and feeds it into a graph autoencoder, trains node representations using reconstruction error, and then learns temporal dependencies through a recurrent neural network, enabling efficient large-scale sequential graph representation learning.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
通过循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment
Compress the original graph through graph summarization technology
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder, and use the reconstruction error with the original graph to train representations of original graph nodes
Learn feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the time dimension through a recurrent neural network
